extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of the history of mathematics; researchers interested in ancient Greek geometry
extracted.subtask_description: A textbook/chapter excerpt surveying classical solutions to the duplication of the cube and discussing Zeno of Elea's paradoxes and their impact on Greek mathematical thought. Focuses on historical exposition of constructions (Menaechmus, Plato, Eratosthenes, Nicomedes, Diocles, etc.) and philosophical implications.
